answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 40 per proof, 18680 for 467, owed every epoch with no exception. Put Dollmaker toy horse proof counted beside the market stall on the table and the farm goes quiet, because each toy horse is a run of sanded edges logged against the master pattern is not a thing a printer can paint. Every saffron has a toy shop behind it, every reef a ledger, every lotus a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. A hundred keys, zero proofs: the farm's story, told the same way each epoch.
